senses.gloss: (b. h.; Assyr. šabaṭu) Shebat, the eleventh month of the Jewish calendar, of thirty days, beginning between the first and the thirtieth of January, and ending between the thirtieth of January and the twenty-eighth of February.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Zechariah 1:7">Targ. Zech. I, 7</cite>; a. e.—
